args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production (error rate ~18%) across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) following its latest deploy. Action taken: rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent previously-healthy production release, in all regions. Rollback has been verified as healthy (error rate now ~0.2%).
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened and what I did:

1. **Diagnosed:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (deployed across us-east, us-west, eu-west) was unhealthy with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Identified healthy version:** Checked the release history — v2.3.0 was the most recent release that had been healthy in production.
3. **Rolled back:** Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions. Verified post-rollback health: service is now healthy with a ~0.2% error rate.
4. **Opened incident:** Filed a SEV2 incident (`INC-0001`) for checkout-api describing the failures and the rollback action, and the on-call engineer has been paged.
